import asyncio
from typing import Annotated
import fastmcp
from fastmcp.context import get_context

app = fastmcp.FastMCP("progress-reporter")

@app.tool()
async def process_items(
    items: Annotated[list[str], "List of items to process"]
) -> str:
    """Process a list of items and report progress via MCP context logging."""
    context = get_context()
    
    total = len(items)
    context.log.info(f"Starting to process {total} items")
    
    for i, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        # Report progress via MCP context
        context.log.info(f"[{i}/{total}] Processing: {item}")
        
        # Simulate processing work
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    
    context.log.info(f"Completed processing all {total} items")
    return f"Successfully processed {total} items"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    fastmcp.run(app)
